BREAKFAST 01
Yogurt, fruit and Wildflower
Fresh, colorful, and ready in minutes.
TIME
5 minutes
DIFFICULTY
Very easy
SERVES
1 person
INGREDIENTS PREPARE IT LIKE THIS
150 g of plain yogurt
100 g of seasonal fruit
2 tablespoons of rolled oats
1 teaspoon of Wildflower honey
01 Pour the yogurt into a bowl.
02 Add the fruit and rolled oats.
03 Finish with the honey just before
serving.
RECOMMENDED HONEY
Wildflower
Soft and balanced: it binds yogurt, cereals, and
fruit.

BREAKFAST 01 · VARIATIONS AND IDEAS
Make it even more yours
THREE VARIATIONS
01 Peach
Diced peach and a drizzle of Wildflower Honey.
02 Berries
Well-drained blueberries, raspberries, or strawberries.
03 Apple and cinnamon
Thin apple slices, cinnamon, and toasted oats.
GET ORGANIZED AHEAD
01 Prepare in advance
Wash and cut the fruit the night before. Keep
cereals and honey separate; add them
when ready.
02 Substitutions
Yogurt, Greek yogurt, or ricotta. Oats or
granola. Fruit according to the season.
MY VARIATION
FOR 2 PEOPLE · 300 g yogurt · 200 g fruit · 4
tablespoons oats · 2 teaspoons Wildflower Honey

BREAKFAST 02
Toasted bread, ricotta and Acacia
Crispy, creamy and delicate.
TIME
7 minutes
DIFFICULTY
Very easy
SERVES
1 person
INGREDIENTS PREPARE IT LIKE THIS
2 slices of rustic bread
80 g of fresh ricotta
1 teaspoon of Acacia honey
3 walnut kernels
01 Toast the bread until golden brown.
02 Spread the ricotta on the still-warm slices.
03 Add honey and chopped walnuts.
RECOMMENDED HONEY
Acacia
Light and delicate: it sweetens without masking the ricotta.

BREAKFAST 02 · VARIATIONS AND IDEAS
A simple slice, done
right
THREE VARIATIONS
01 Pear and walnuts
Pear slices, crushed walnuts and Acacia.
02 Apple and cinnamon
Thin apple slices, a little cinnamon and honey.
03 Dried fruit
Chopped almonds or hazelnuts on top of the ricotta.
THE LITTLE TRICK
01 Warm bread
Spread the ricotta while the bread is still
slightly warm: it becomes softer and
adheres better.
PRESENTATION
01 For two
4 slices, 160 g of ricotta, 2 teaspoons of Acacia
and 6 walnuts.
NOTES
THE RIGHT ORDER · Warm bread → ricotta → fruit →
honey → dried fruit

BREAKFAST 03
Apple and Chestnut Porridge
Warm and comforting, for slow mornings.
TIME
12 minutes
DIFFICULTY
Easy
SERVES
1 person
INGREDIENTS PREPARE IT THIS WAY
40 g of rolled oats
180 ml of milk or plant-based drink
1/2 apple, diced
Cinnamon to taste
1 teaspoon of Chestnut honey
01 Simmer the oats in the milk for 6-8
minutes.
02 Add the apple for the last 3 minutes.
03 Pour into a bowl and finish with
cinnamon and honey.
RECOMMENDED HONEY
Chestnut
Intense and low in sweetness: it adds character to the
creamy base.

03

BREAKFAST 03 · VARIATIONS AND IDEAS
The perfect porridge
CHOOSE THE CONSISTENCY
01 Soft
180 ml of liquid.
02 Creamy and thick
160 ml, stirring often.
03 Thinner
200 ml, added little by little.
TOPPINGS AND ORGANIZATION
01 Three toppings
Hazelnuts, apple, and cinnamon.
02 The night before
Cook it slightly thinner. Warm it with
a little milk and add honey at the end.
WHY CHESTNUT
01 The contrast
The bold flavor works well with oats, milk,
and apple; just a teaspoon is enough.
MY PORRIDGE
PRACTICAL RULE · Adjust the consistency only at
the end, one spoonful of milk at a time.

BREAKFAST 04
Banana and Orange Honey Pancakes
Soft, fragrant, and perfect for sharing.
TIME
15 minutes
DIFFICULTY
Easy
SERVES
1-2 people
INGREDIENTS PREPARE AS FOLLOWS
1 ripe banana
1 egg
40 g of flour
2-3 tablespoons of milk
1 teaspoon of Orange Honey
01 Mash the banana and combine with the
egg, flour, and milk.
02 Cook small pancakes in a lightly greased pan.
03 Serve warm with Orange Honey.
RECOMMENDED HONEY
Orange Honey
Sweet and citrusy: makes the pancakes more vibrant.

BREAKFAST 05
Crunchy Honey Granola
A golden stash for many mornings.
TIME
30 minutes
DIFFICULTY
Easy
SERVES
6 portions
INGREDIENTS PREPARE IT LIKE THIS
150 g of rolled oats
60 g of almonds or hazelnuts
30 g of mixed seeds
2 tablespoons of Millefiori honey
1 tablespoon of seed oil
01 Mix all the ingredients.
02 Spread on a baking sheet and bake at 160 °C
for 20-25 minutes.
03 Turn halfway through cooking and let
cool completely.
RECOMMENDED HONEY
Millefiori
Round and versatile: it evenly distributes sweetness
and aroma.

Clean and tightly sealed, away from heat and

porridge.

only when it is completely cold.

Mixed Fruit Salad with Peach Honey
Colors, freshness, and a scent of summer.

10 minutes

Very Easy

300 g of mixed fresh fruit
1 teaspoon of lemon juice

02 Add a few drops of lemon and mix.
03 Finish with the honey just before serving.
RECOMMENDED HONEY
Peach Honey
Soft and fruity: it complements the fruit without weighing it down.

BREAKFAST 08
Banana and Honey Smoothie
Creamy and quick, even on rushed mornings.
TIME
5 minutes
DIFFICULTY
Very easy
SERVES
1 person
INGREDIENTS PREPARE IT THIS WAY
1 banana
150 g yogurt or 180 ml milk
3 ice cubes
1 teaspoon Millefiori honey
01 Put all the ingredients in the
blender.
02 Blend until creamy.
03 Taste and add honey only if
needed.
RECOMMENDED HONEY
Millefiori
Balanced and fragrant: it complements the banana
without overpowering it.

formula

FOUR COMBINATIONS

BREAKFAST 09
Cold strawberry porridge
Prepare it the night before and it's ready in the morning.
TIME
5 min + rest
DIFFICULTY
Very easy
SERVES
1 person
INGREDIENTS PREPARE IT THIS WAY
40 g rolled oats
120 g yogurt
60 ml milk
5 strawberries
1 teaspoon Strawberry Honey
01 In the evening, mix oats, yogurt, and
milk in a jar.
02 Close and let it rest in the refrigerator.
03 In the morning, add strawberries and honey.
RECOMMENDED HONEY
Strawberry Honey
Sweet and fruity: enhances the fresh part of
the jar.
